about: Regular legislative sessions for 2025, 2026 and 2027 for the 50 states, D.C. (Council legislative periods) and the five territories. 'meets' says whether the body holds a regular session that year; sessions give the convening date and the sine die adjournment ('full-year' where the body meets throughout the year). Each year row has a tag (SOURCED, or ESTIMATED with the rule as its comments) and its source. specialSession holds the constitutional rule for calling special sessions. sessionEnds (below) is the separate table of session-end limits the effective-date rules count from.

ncsl2025.title: 2025 Legislative Session Calendar (updated Feb. 3, 2025)
ncsl2025.note: The asterisk means the legislature meets throughout the year.

ncsl2026.title: 2026 State Legislative Session Calendar
ncsl2026.note: The PDF's asterisk means the legislature meets throughout the year. Dates and comments preserve the NCSL table as updated March 23, 2026.

guam.title: Guam Code Annotated, Title 2, Chapter 1, § 1101
guam.note: The regular session begins in January and may continue until the day before the next regular session.

americanSamoa.title: Revised Constitution of American Samoa, art. II, § 8
americanSamoa.note: Two regular sessions begin on the second Monday in January and July and last 45 legislative days; calendar adjournment dates are not specified in the source.

northernMarianaIslands.title: Constitution of the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, art. II, § 13
northernMarianaIslands.publisher: Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands Law Revision Commission
northernMarianaIslands.note: The Legislature is a continuous body for the two years between its organizational meetings on the second Monday of January following a general election.

puertoRico.title: Laws of Puerto Rico, tit. 2, § 1a
puertoRico.publisher: Puerto Rico Office of Legislative Services (compiled text)
puertoRico.note: The first annual regular session begins the second Monday in January and adjourns June 30; the second begins the third Monday in August and adjourns on the date set in the statute.

dc.title: D.C. Official Code § 1-204.11
dc.publisher: Council of the District of Columbia
dc.note: The Council's two-year legislative period begins on January 2 of each odd-numbered year; the Council meets throughout both years.

rule2027.title: Convening and adjournment rules of each legislature's constitution or statute, applied to 2027
rule2027.note: No 2027 calendar is published yet. Each ESTIMATED 2027 row carries the rule that sets its dates: the convening date is the same weekday-of-month rule the 2025 session followed, and the adjournment is the statutory or constitutional limit where one fixes a date, else the 2025 session's length counted from the 2027 convening date.
